mentions.name: Ahay
mentions.description: This app is a PDF tool that merges multiple expense receipts onto a single page, reducing paper use when printing expense reports. It was the builder's first coding project and is offered free of charge.
mentions.problem: Printing expense reports wastes paper, with receipts typically taking up a full page each.
mentions.source_excerpt: Built my first coding project – a PDF merger that fits multiple receipts per page.

evidence.value: Built my first coding project – a PDF merger that fits multiple receipts per page.
